chunks: In fact man is a witness against himself,
ai.seo_question: Who will testify against a person on the Day of Judgment according to Surah Al-Qiyamah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted to mean that the human soul possesses an innate, intuitive clarity (basirah) regarding its own state, making self-condemnation inevitable without the need for external proof. It underscores the concept of 'self-witnessing' (shahid al-nafs), where one's own conscience and accumulated deeds serve as the primary evidence in the divine court. This highlights the internalization of accountability, a key theme in Shi'a moral theology regarding the purification of the self (tazkiyah).
